Name: Top Surgery Shirts Collection for Fashion Sense
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
A simple fashion sense mod, I wanted to share it with people because I saw there weren't many cosmetic mods for people like me.
[size=4]

if you have a bug/problem, I will need an error log in order to help you.
Here is the link to the log parser: -> [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io[/url]

REQUIRES: Fashion Sense, and SMAPI.

links to both:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion sense[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]


INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS: Place the .zip folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder on your device, And unzip the files.[/size]



[size=2]I hope this mod is acceptable to the moderators. If not, I will take it down.[/size]



If you want to request a skin color, I am more than happy to make one for you. Just please specify the colors, or provide an image.
I am also open to suggestions.
[size=3]Current language: English

[/size]

Downloads.Description: Removed color masks, made it so you can have your top surgery scar shirts while in the bathhouse (swimming area), tweaked the pixel art slightly, updated format.
